blocks.en: Text-to-SQL systems over large pooled catalogs must first retrieve the tables a question needs. We compare against the published table recall of RASL, which uses Claude 3.5 models to extract keywords and select tables, on pooled BIRD, Spider, and Fiben catalogs. FERN (Feature-Engineered Ranking with No generative LLM) instead fuses three frozen retrievers into 100 candidates, describes each with up to 120 features, and reorders them with LightGBM rankers fitted once on BIRD's training questions. On Spider, where it was not fitted, its candidate pool alone reaches RASL's published recall at fifteen tables (98.0), and the ranker raises the share of questions with every gold table in the top five (complete@5) from 83.9% to 95.6%. At five tables, FERN's recall is within one point of RASL's on Spider (96.7 vs 97.0) and on BIRD with its evidence hints (96.6 vs 97.5), and 8.2 points below on BIRD without them (89.3). On 121 real BEAVER questions, without BEAVER fitting, its recall at fifteen (82.1) falls between two BEAVER-trained retrievers (80.8, 84.5), but its complete@15 is below both (49.6 vs 54.5 and 62.0). On Fiben, it falls far short at fifteen tables (54.2 vs 69.2, different question sets), although its recall at fifty is numerically close to RASL's question-only retrieval result (80.7 vs 79.4). On BIRD dev with evidence, non-retrieval features raise complete@5 by 7.7 points over retrieval signals alone. On BIRD dev, median latency is 208 ms per question on one A100, without hosted model calls.
blocks.zh: 文字到SQL系统在大型集合目录上必须首先取回表格中需要的问题。 我们比较了RASL公布的表格召回,该表格使用克洛德3.5模型提取关键词并选取表格,关于集合的BIRD,蜘蛛和Fiben目录. FERN(Feature-Engineered Ranking with no generalive LLM)取而代之,将3个被冻结的取回器装入100个入选者,描述每个入选者最多120个特征,并重新排列它们,在BIRD的训练题上安装过一次的LightGBM分级器. 在Spider上,没有安装它,其候选者池单在15个表(98.0个表)中达到RASL公布的召回,排名将前5个表(完成@5)中每个金表的提问比例从83.9%提高到95.6%. 在5个表格中,FERN的召回在RASL的"蜘蛛"(96.7 vs 97.0)和"BIRD"的1分之内,并附有其证据提示(96.6 vs 97.5),而下面的"BIRD"则有8.2分没有这些提示(89.3). 关于121个真正的BEAVER问题,没有BEAVER的合适性,15 (82.1)时的召回位于两个BEAVER训练有素的取回器之间(80.8,84.5),但其完整的"15"都低于两者(49.6对54.5和62.0)。 在Fiben上,在15个表格(54.2对69.2,不同的问题集)中它远远不够,尽管它在50分时的召回数字上接近RASL的只问检索结果(80.7对79.4). 在有证据的BIRD dev上,非检索功能仅通过检索信号就以7.7分提升完成@5. 在BIRD dev上,中位延迟为一A100上每题208ms,没有主机型号呼叫.
